The powerplant limitations in §§ 3.745 through

3.747 shall be established and shall not exceed the corresponding limits established as a part of the type certification of the engine and propeller installed in the airplane.

The powerplant limitations set forth in this section shall be established for the airplane. The limitations shall not exceed the corresponding limits established as part of the type certification of the engine and propeller installed in the airplane. (a) Takeoff operation. (1) mum rotational speed (r.p.m.); (2) Maximum permissible manifold pressure; (3 Maximum permissible gas temperature ; (4) The time limit for use of the power or thrust which corresponds with the values established in subparagraphs (1) through (3) of this paragraph; and (5) When the time limit established in subparagraph (4) of this paragraph exceeds 2 minutes, the maximum permissible cylinder head, oil, and liquid coolant temperatures, (b) Mazimum continuous operation, (1) Maximum rotational speed (r.p.m.) ; (2), Maximum permissible manifold pressure; (3) Maximum permissible gas temperature; and (4) Maximum permissible cylinder head, oil, and liquid coolant temperatures, (c) Fuel grade or specification designation.
